subject: Commercial ops confirmation & security artifacts for BrightPath pilot
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@brightpathhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 5 Jul 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap & next steps from today's pilot kickoff call

Hi Elena,

Great to meet you and Brad on the call earlier — thanks for walking through the pilot goals. Short recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

- What we heard: BrightPath wants a 6-week pilot to validate fidelity on patient-note summarization and speed (95th pct latency target < 250ms for the key route). You indicated procurement typically prefers a PO and that security will need SOC 2 Type II + an executed DPA and a filled security questionnaire. Marketplace billing (Azure) is interesting but not a blocker for the pilot.

- Commercial options we discussed:
  * Quick-start hosted API (fastest) — paid by card or PO; easiest for pilot.
  * Dedicated (reserved capacity) — recommended if you need stronger data isolation and predictable throughput.
  * Marketplace (Azure) — simplifies procurement later but onboarding takes longer.

- Immediate asks / owners:
  1) Elena/BrightPath: confirm procurement contact (name + email) and whether PO flow or card is required for pilot (due Tue 7/7).
  2) BrightPath security: confirm the security questionnaire point of contact and whether you need a signed DPA before pilot (due Tue 7/7).
  3) Redwood (Dylan): share pricing spreadsheet, SOC 2 cert, DPA draft, and security questionnaire (attached).

Attachments: product_pricing_v2.pdf, security_one_pager.pdf (see attached stubs).

If PO is preferred we can provide an invoice template and nominal billing contact to loop into the PO. If you want to go marketplace later we’ll map out the timeline, but recommend starting hosted API for speed.

I’ll follow up after I hear procurement/contact details and will loop in Marissa for the commercial handoff and Karthik for security artifacts.

Thanks,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

------------------------------

From: Elena Morales <elena@brightpathhealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap & next steps from today's pilot kickoff call

Thanks Dylan — quick answers below and I attached our procurement intake form (procurement_form.pdf).

- Procurement: We prefer PO for anything > $10k and our standard procurement contact is Brad Turner (brad.turner@brightpathhealth.com). Typical PO window is ~3–4 weeks once contract terms/DPA are agreed. For the pilot we can try to do a PO; if timing forces it we can use a corporate card and then move to PO for the pilot extension.
- Marketplace: We like the idea of Azure Marketplace for long-term billing consolidation, but our vendor marketplace onboarding historically adds 6–8 weeks. We want to pilot on hosted API first.
- Security gating: Security requires SOC 2 Type II, a signed DPA, and a completed vendor questionnaire. Their team will review the DPA and the questionnaire. Primary security reviewer is Kara Lim (kara.lim@brightpathhealth.com).
- Data residency: We run in Azure East US and would prefer region-matched hosting if possible.

We can target the pilot start window starting 7/20 if we can have DPA and procurement lined up early.

Elena Morales
VP, Clinical Operations
BrightPath Health

------------------------------

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@brightpathhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Jul 2026 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap & next steps from today's pilot kickoff call

Thanks Elena — helpful. Quick notes:

- PO path: good to have Brad as the procurement contact. Marissa, can you take the procurement handoff once we have the DPA terms? I’ll provide the invoice template and pricing rows (attached earlier).
- Marketplace: agree — pilot on hosted API first. We’ll scope marketplace separately.
- Region: we can spin up hosted nodes in Azure East US for the pilot. Karthik — can you confirm the SOC 2 certificate and DPA availability and whether we need any additional attestation for Azure tenancy?

Action: Marissa will coordinate PO/invoice steps with Brad; Karthik will send artifacts to Kara (BrightPath security).

I’ll pause on any contractual redlines until we hear back from security/procurement.

— Dylan

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@brightpathhealth.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2, DPA draft, and vendor questionnaire (next steps)

Hi Elena / team — looping in the security artifacts you asked for. 

What I attached:
- SOC2_cert_2025.pdf (public attestation for our hosted service)
- RINF_DPA_draft.docx (baseline DPA we sign with customers)
- security_questionnaire.xlsx (common questionnaire with our standard answers)

Notes / requests:
1) Please share Kara Lim's preferred email and any additional evidence points they want (e.g., penetration test reports or specific control mappings).
2) On the DPA: the attached is our standard customer-facing draft. If you have specific legal redlines, please flag them and we’ll route to our legal team (we can often turn around simple DPA redlines in ~3 business days).
3) Marketplace: if you later prefer Azure Marketplace billing we can provide the necessary marketplace docs — note that marketplace listing is separate from the DPA and will take extra time.

Next steps proposed:
- Kara to confirm if the SOC 2 PDF + questionnaire is sufficient for initial review (target: 7/9).
- BrightPath legal to review DPA (target: 7/13) — if accepted we can issue a pilot PO.
- Marissa to coordinate invoicing template and PO information for Brad.

HubSpot ref: https://hubspot.com/deals/12345 (internal)

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Applied ML / Security Liaison
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Morales <elena@brightpathhealth.com>

Date: Thu, 8 Jul 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2, DPA draft, and vendor questionnaire (next steps)

Thanks Karthik — received the attachments. Quick update: 

- Kara confirmed SOC 2 PDF + the questionnaire are enough for initial review. She asked for any pen-test summary if available, but said that may not block our PO.
- Legal will start DPA review today and we should have comments by 7/13. Procurement (Brad) is looped and will initiate the PO once legal signs off; plan is to issue PO within ~3 weeks.
- For the pilot we will proceed with hosted API in Azure East US. Marketplace is something we’ll evaluate after pilot success.

Procurement contact: Brad Turner <brad.turner@brightpathhealth.com>
Security contact: Kara Lim <kara.lim@brightpathhealth.com>

I’ll share any DPA comments as they come in. We are targeting a pilot start in the 7/20–7/27 window.

Best,
Elena

Attachments: procurement_form.pdf
